configuration:
# Axiward: this worker must use the named native profile.
default_permissions = "axiward_worker"
approval_policy = { granular = { sandbox_approval = false, rules = false, mcp_elicitations = true, request_permissions = false, skill_approval = false } }

[windows]
sandbox = "elevated"

[features]
apps = false
plugins = false
hooks = false
browser_use = false
computer_use = false

[permissions.axiward_worker]
filesystem = { ":root" = "read", "AXIWARD/.work/native-isolation-03/view" = "read", "AXIWARD/.work/native-isolation-03/view/work" = "write", "AXIWARD/.work/native-isolation-03/view/tmp" = "write", "AXIWARD/.work/native-isolation-03/project.git" = "deny", "AXIWARD/.lake/build/bin" = "deny", "AXIWARD/.work/native-isolation-03/project.git.checks" = "deny", "AXIWARD/adapter" = "deny" }
network = { enabled = true }

[shell_environment_policy.set]
TMP = "AXIWARD\\.work\\native-isolation-03\\view\\tmp"
TEMP = "AXIWARD\\.work\\native-isolation-03\\view\\tmp"

[mcp_servers.axiward]
command = "USER_HOME\\scoop\\apps\\python311\\current\\python.exe"
args = ["-E","-s","AXIWARD\\adapter\\server.py","--exe","AXIWARD\\.lake\\build\\bin\\axiward.exe","--repo","AXIWARD\\.work\\native-isolation-03\\project.git","--view","AXIWARD\\.work\\native-isolation-03\\view","--worker","8807dc8a0810cd8b0330efb493ad6dc90b40f218d3ad97dc00cee765b4daf231"]
startup_timeout_sec = 30
tool_timeout_sec = 600
default_tools_approval_mode = "approve"

[mcp_servers."codex_app"]
enabled = false
command = "AXIWARD\\.lake\\build\\bin\\axiward.exe"
args = ["--version"]

[mcp_servers."cua_repl"]
enabled = false
command = "AXIWARD\\.lake\\build\\bin\\axiward.exe"
args = ["--version"]

[mcp_servers."node_repl"]
enabled = false
command = "AXIWARD\\.lake\\build\\bin\\axiward.exe"
args = ["--version"]

[mcp_servers."openaiDeveloperDocs"]
enabled = false
url = "https://disabled.invalid"
tailEvents: {"error": {"code": -32600, "message": "custom outputBytesCap is not supported with windows sandbox"}, "id": 41}
